sentence: This project runs a shared screening service that helps cancer researchers find chemical starting points and drug targets using libraries of small molecules.
This project studies how a drug called edelfosine affects gut microbes, gut and brain communication, and immune cells after an epileptic insult.
This project aims to help cell and gene based therapies move from basic science laboratories into clinical development.
This project studies which hosts carry dangerous forms of Toxoplasma gondii, where they may live, and how they changed over time.
This project builds a 3D in vitro model of a dementia related to Alzheimer's disease to help develop biomarkers and treatments.
This project tries to find out whether changing how bladder cancer cells use glucose can stop bladder cancer from coming back and getting worse.
This project studies how platelets and coagulation form blood clots.
This project studies a protein that may control blood vessel growth and inflammation.
This project uses machine learning and computer tools to study how neuronal cell types develop and how kinase networks go wrong in neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project studies a single enzyme that changes many proteins and how gene mutations in it cause a form of intellectual disability.
This project tests whether defects in a cell structure called the primary cilium cause faulty brain circuits and epileptic seizures.
This project offers live imaging, electrophysiology and data analysis resources for studying living systems in three dimensions.
This project holds a conference to share tools and practices for reaching underserved communities and reducing the burden of cancer.
This project studies gene activity in immune cells to learn how a vaccine makes rhesus macaques stop a virus from replicating.
This project supports cancer patients in clinical trials by making cell therapies and tracking how their immune systems respond.
This project develops ways to combine data from many vaccine trials to learn how well a vaccine protects each person.
This project builds fast computer methods to analyze brain images and predict Alzheimer's disease dementia and cognitive decline.
This project improves whole brain coverage and reliability of spectroscopic MRI for detecting neurological disorders.
This project tests how a kinase protein works to understand a rare pediatric neurodevelopmental disorder.
This project studies how mitochondrial and nuclear signaling protects dopaminergic neurons from oxidative stress in Parkinson's disease.
